notes.evidence: Real author checkpoint on CPU, populated specimen output and empty blank control. See src/probe/reports/2026-09-30-format-expansion/biomoth/report.json for exact invocation and scope. This is a format probe, not an accuracy evaluation.
notes.representation: One CSV table decoded using the header as field names. Numeric cells may be safely cast to the declared types; the author writes CSV, not JSON objects.
notes.scope: Active batch export predictions_2023.csv after TorchScript inference, confidence filtering, NMS and undoing letterbox padding. Excludes commented single-image CSV exports and downstream biomass aggregation.
notes.coordinates: X_Min,Y_Min,X_Max,Y_Max are floating-point original-image pixel corners, clipped to image bounds. d_X and d_Y are pixel width/height.
notes.measurements: d_X_cm=d_X*(83/6040), d_Y_cm=d_Y*(44/3420); size is their product in square centimetres. These are hard-coded author calibration factors, not calibration for arbitrary images.
notes.identity: year is hard-coded to 2023; site comes from LOCATIONS; filePath is site/fileName. The single-class branch assigns class 0; float serialization such as 0.0 is safely castable to integer.
notes.confidence: Detector confidence in [0,1]; notebook defaults CONF_THRES=0.25 and IOU_THRES=0.50.
notes.empty: Images without retained detections contribute no rows, so the CSV alone cannot distinguish them from unprocessed images. A header is written even when the first image has no detections.
